summary: SyncActivity replication returns nil instead of RetryReplication error when the target workflow is not found, preventing the retry/resend mechanism from being triggered and silently dropping replication tasks.
userImpact: Replication events may be silently dropped when workflows are not found in the target cluster, potentially causing data loss and replication failures without error notification.
rootCause: Code at activity_state_replicator.go:214 returns nil instead of serviceerrors.NewRetryReplication when a NotFound error is encountered, preventing the existing retry/resend logic from executing.
proposedFix: Return serviceerrors.NewRetryReplication instead of nil when workflow is not found, allowing the existing resend path to properly handle the case.
keyQuote: Replication tasks are silently dropped when workflow not found
